snippet.title: Wildaria - Alpha Playtest Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Use Skill-Based Taming to collect pets to explore a Procedural Action-Adventure RPG World. Progress your character and your pets through fighting, questing, trading. Will you choose to protect nature from mana drills or advance civilization by slaying the Animal Gods?
